review.finding: BehindAlert close timer is never cleared on unmount / when the popover closes another way (Escape).
mouse-vs-touch gate is a ref set only on pointerenter and reset only on keydown; a click with no preceding pointerenter (assistive tech, hybrid devices) can be swallowed so the popover cannot open.
Accessibility: the old chip had role=status; the new alert has no announcement and the popover has no accessible name.
No hover-intent delay on open; acceptable.
Popover hardcodes white-on-triage-lane-solid and shadow-lg instead of the sibling popovers' shared tokens; fine only while --triage-lane-solid is always dark.
Unit tests only cover click; missing touch tap open/close, keyboard toggle, hover-leave close delay and Escape.
Class-string assertions are brittle; the e2e is the real no-wrap proof.
e2e only at 1500px viewport and matches only the exact /api/triage/<id> path.
